ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 white-to-black pixel ratio; high contrast between the dark central peduncle/notch area and the bright lateral distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches on the distal halves of both lobes. Left lobe: White region with irregular black pixel mottling centered at [X:15%, Y:40%]. Right lobe: Expansive solid white region starting at [X:70%, Y:35%] and extending to the distal tip, characterized by a feathered interior boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an estimated internal pixel angle of 72 degrees; base of the notch is partially occluded by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Sharp peaks (amplitudes of 10-15 pixels) are concentrated on the medial trailing edge of both lobes. The right lobe exhibits a prominent notch-adjacent protrusion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to upward-turned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular, high-intensity, raised pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions (dark on white) visible on the left lobe's white patch, oriented roughly 80 degrees relative to the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) on the leading and trailing edges of both fluke tips, causing localized structural irregularities.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive feathered or 'bleeding' transition zone between the black and white pigmentation on the right lobe's interior boundary.
